chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Jaʿfar, from his father, peace be upon them both.

That ʿAlī عليه السلام was brought one who consumed riba, so he sought his repentance, and he repented; then he let him go. Then he said: “The consumer of riba is to be asked to repent from riba just as one is asked to repent from shirk.”

key_terms.الرِّبَا: usury or unlawful gain through interest
key_terms.يُسْتَتَابُ: he is asked to repent and return from the act

ai.seo_question: How does Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام treat the one who consumes riba in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a person who consumes riba is to be called to repentance, and if he repents he is released. It emphasizes the grave seriousness of riba by comparing the demand for repentance from it to repentance from shirk, indicating its severe legal and moral weight.
